metadata.title: Universal Patterns & Systems Dynamics
metadata.notes: Foundational 'Grammar of Nature' for all disciplines.

nodes.title: The Math of Growth: Fractals & Power Laws
nodes.description: Understanding how nature builds. Fractals, Fibonacci sequences, and power-law distributions in living systems, cities, and mesh networks. Why scale matters.

nodes.title: Systems Dynamics & Feedback Loops
nodes.description: Thinking in loops. Positive and negative feedback, delayed signals, and the unintended consequences of centralized interventions. Modeling ecological and economic balance.

nodes.title: The Physics of Phase Transitions
nodes.description: Why things suddenly change. From individual agents to collective swarms. Understanding critical points, tipping points, and emergent order in decentralized systems.

nodes.title: Biological Homeostasis & Social Ubuntu
nodes.description: The parallel between the body's internal balance and the community's social health. How individual 'errors' are corrected by the collective substrate to maintain the whole.

edges.rationale: Understanding power-law distributions is required for modeling critical points in phase transitions.
Systems dynamics provide the causal intuition for thermodynamic governance.
Biological homeostasis is the spiritual model for Ubuntu stewardship.
